payload.body: Swift WS sync telemetry shipped and verified on main (commit 696b305b): FrickSyncSocket emits client span 'WebSocket /_frick/sync' with network.protocol.name/url.path/frick.schema_id/frick.schema_revision/frick.authenticated, finished ok|error + close_code/close_category, per-frame sent/received counters, and frick.client.ws.connection.duration_ms histogram — parity with TS runtime.ts. (Board status was lost in a parallel rebase; implementation + 5 new tests are on main, integrated swift test = 133 passing.)
